decision: Close direct use of the frozen Hangzhou by-count response values as a candidate for control evaluation. Preserve the replicated local response direction and the held-out scores.
next_step: Use server-side saved starts and event windows for the 14 Hangzhou and 28 fresh Jinan cases to describe why the same two inlet counts can produce different realized magnitudes.
comparison: For each common count point and seed, read the focal vehicles' t0 distance to the stop line and speed from the saved lane geometry and physical starts, and their observed stop-line entries in each arm from the 10-second event windows. Retain complete case counts and both directions. Start with the straight movement where the frozen same-point prediction was high in 20 of 28 cases. Compare source and target on the same near definition and nominal/actual exposure. Report descriptive associations and missing measurements.
scope: The four previously fresh seeds now serve as diagnostic data. Any later revised predictor or action rule needs an untouched validation cohort. Further study of source information would require comparison against the same target-only construction.
transfer: Read existing records on the node; only compact summaries leave the server.
